pull.title: KAFKA-21209: Add client telemetry integration tests
pull.body:
The integration testing of KIP-714 lacks proper validation of the
metrics pushed and state transitions. While there are plenty of unit
tests, there's a bit of a gap for integration tests. This PR takes a
step towards improving this.

While working on these tests, it became clear that only the consumer was
sending the terminating push correctly, so this PR also includes
improvements to the producer and admin client.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <claude@anthropic.com>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

commit.message: KAFKA-21209: Add client telemetry integration tests
Add dependencies for compression libraries in clients integration tests

files.patch:
@@ -2253,6 +2253,12 @@ project(':clients:clients-integration-tests') {
     testImplementation project(':storage')
     testImplementation testFixtures(project(':storage'))
     testImplementation testFixtures(project(':clients'))
+    testImplementation project(path: ':clients', configuration: 'shadow')
+    // The clients shadow jar excludes the compression libraries which are runtime dependencies in
+    // its pom, so they must be added explicitly for the tests which use compression.
+    testRuntimeOnly libs.snappy
+    testRuntimeOnly libs.zstd
+    testRuntimeOnly libs.lz4
     implementation project(':server-common')
     testImplementation testFixtures(project(':server-common'))
     implementation project(':group-coordinator')
